newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: J.P. MORGAN TO LEAD $100 MLN LITHUANIA SYNDICATE.
newsitem.headline: J.P. MORGAN TO LEAD $100 MLN LITHUANIA SYNDICATE.

text.p: The Lithuanian finance ministry said on Thursday it selected J.P. Morgan to lead manage a $100 million syndicated loan, which will be for three years and priced at LIBOR plus 0.45 basis points.
"The date of receiving the loan will be agreed in the near future with the winning bank," the finance ministry said in a statement.
A finance ministry official said funds from the loan would be used to finance the country's budget deficit.
This is the second time this year Lithuania has tapped financial markets. It launched a five-year, $200 million eurobond in early July with a 7.125-percent coupon.
